Title: AI Yi Yi: Emerging Issues with Artificial Intelligence
Description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology is advancing in ways that surprise even its creators. In one recent example, a team of AI "agents" broke out of a containment, set up a message board so they could communicate secretly, escaped into the Internet, and hacked servers in another company's lab. Starting with a brief history, we will examine recent developments in AI technology, and the issues that these developments raise.
Speaker: Michael Trigoboff

Title: Social Media in the Era of AI
Description: This lecture will address how we can navigate the promise and the peril of social media technologies in the age of artificial intelligence. Dr. Davis will discuss the evolution of social media from the early days of platforms such as Twitter and Facebook whose purpose was to connect families and friends to what have become behemoth technology companies that are marketing and news powerhouses. Attendees will gain insight to better understand both the strengths and vulnerabilities of today's social media and how they influence our culture.
Speaker: Donna Z. Davis
